Central London Office Market Watch Q3 2025 27 October 2025 Article
Leasing activity slowed in Q3, with take-up reaching 1.9 million sq ft across 167 transactions.
overall supply standing at 20.2 million sq ft, equating to a vacancy rate of 7.8%
The City vacancy rate stood at 7.4%, down 10 bps
West End vacancy rate rose by 20 bps over the quarter to 8.3%
City Fringe vacancy rate, which currently stands at 8.3%
The preference for newer quality offices is reflected by the fact that recently redeveloped or comprehensively refurbished office space accounted for 70% of space acquired so far this year, with BREEAM-rated Excellent and Outstanding offices representing 61% of space acquired.
